confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded from aggregated cost-of-living guides and menu data. The sources disagree, and some are dated. Wine by the glass has no direct price data, so it is derived from the bottle price and the beer relationship (low confidence). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no listings were inspected. The FX observation could not be verified: the single permitted RBA search did not return a current published observation, so the fx rate fields are null and must be supplied before conversion.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors are based on Mérida-specific aggregated price guides and menu data, converted at roughly 17 MXN per USD. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for a mid-sized Mexican tourist city with Mérida-like demand. No single comparable city was used.
